name: IFEval
description: Instruction Following Evaluation tests models on approximately 500 prompts containing 25 types of verifiable constraints, including word count limits, required keywords, format specifications (JSON, markdown), letter case requirements, and negative constraints (words to avoid). All scoring is fully deterministic and reproducible without LLM judges.
evaluation_method: accuracy (deterministic rule-based verification of constraint satisfaction)
reputation: One of six core benchmarks on HuggingFace Open LLM Leaderboard v2; highly valued for objective, reproducible scoring without LLM judges; released by Google Research; critical for enterprise deployment evaluation
notes: Released November 2023. Deterministic scoring avoids LLM-judge biases. 25 verifiable constraint types test operational controllability — critical for enterprise use. One of six core benchmarks on the HuggingFace Open LLM Leaderboard v2. Top models (e.g., Claude Opus 4.6, Kimi K2.5) achieve ~94% in 2026. Scores correlate with model reliability in production settings.
